description: This Dart source file provides utility functions for exporting byte data to user-selected file locations, primarily via the exportBytes method of the ExportUtils class.

classes.name: ExportUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to export byte data to a file chosen by the user.

methods.name: exportBytes
methods.description: Exports the provided byte data to a user-specified location, optionally using the provided MIME type and suggested filename.
